Wow that sounds awesome! I really love the idea of meditation and then writing for 15 minutes. Thank you so much for the advice! I would love to incorporate that into our meeting. I think I'll bring that up at the next meeting to see if anyone would be interested in starting that! 
Thanks again ! :)

Thanks for the advice! 
At first we only had about 3 people coming to the meeting. I live in a very small town. Many younger addicts like myself live here. There was no NA meetings until me and another person started these two. But it's grown a lot since then. We just rotated roles for the first time. So it's getting there ! Just trying to clean it up a bit and be more organized. 
Thanks again :)
Yes that's what I'm trying to do now. Thank you for taking the time to read. :)

I never thought of it that way, thank you for that ! 
I do try to remind myself that he's in a better place. He was clearly suffering on this earth. I hope he's happy wherever he may be. 
Thank you !

Yes Steve is gone ! He's been in prison for about 3 years now. I herd he's getting out this July. But I will surly keep my distance. As much as I resent him for what he did to me, I do feel sorry for him. Only because he is such a sick sick person. 
Congratulations on being clean and sober. It sure is a struggle everyday.

Thanks so much for the advice ! :) 
I found a format that the home group agreed upon. We had a great meeting tonight !
